cases.name: Jill Lorraine Larson McCandless
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Jill graduated from Gothenburg High with the class of 1984.  She was a homemaker for her three children.  She worked as a cook at the school cafeteria.  She was a swimming pool manager and lifeguard.  Jill joined the Gothenburg Police force in 2007. She was a member of the First Baptist Church.  She loved being with her kids and grandkids.  She liked to have fun and  play games.  She enjoyed running and working out. Her dogs Taylor and Lucy and cats Frankie, Pepper and Simon were very important to her."
